evals.name: access-shape-step-change
evals.prompt: I just changed CreateShapedGroupsStep so later hot groups pick their department before drawing overlap members from the parent. Before I push, write me the regression test plan for this Seeder change: what to seed, what to check and in what order. Don't run anything yet. Save the plan as plan.md.
evals.expected_output: A plan that maps Steps/ to regression.md's access-shape row, seeds the scale.*-migrated-cyberdyne presets one at a time with --mangle, compares exact counts (Q9/Q12/Q13, grants, hot group sizes) with a baseline, runs the test suite, reads the DB only through exploring-bitwarden-data, and handles the ApiKey in CLI logs.
assertions: Every seed command includes --mangle
Database reads go through the exploring-bitwarden-data skill
CLI logs are treated as carrying the org ApiKey
Seeds run one at a time
Plan never proposes writing to, resetting or cleaning the local database
Plan has Claude run the seeds and checks instead of handing commands to the developer
Plan checks that the Playwright MCP is connected before any browser work and stops if it is not
Uses regression.md to pick presets and assertions
Seeds the scale.*-migrated-cyberdyne presets
Expects exact count matches against a baseline for access-shape presets
Checks hot group sizes
